name: Corner Cafe
description: A modest counter with loyal regulars. A steady beginning for an uncertain life.

name: Night Laundry
description: The neighborhood works late. Fresh linen and reliable hours keep cash coming in.

name: Backroom Table
description: A discreet social room where fortunes rise and fall. Its popularity attracts attention.

name: Harbor Diner
description: A warm meal between long shifts. Dockworkers turn a good service into a daily habit.

name: Freight Office
description: A small agency handling ordinary freight contracts. Paperwork buys predictability.

name: Private Cargo
description: An off-book cargo partnership with uncertain clients. The margin matches the scrutiny.

name: Velvet Bar
description: Low lights, excellent service and an expensive address. A meeting place with its own gravity.

name: Midnight Club
description: A late-night venue that survives on a reputation for impeccable service.

name: Private Odds
description: An invitation-only betting room. Large wagers bring large problems.

name: Calder Garage
description: A respected repair workshop gives skilled workers a place to build again.

name: Foundry Contracts
description: A commercial partnership restoring vacant factories. Slow growth has solid foundations.

name: Red Exchange
description: A market for disputed industrial goods. Every windfall comes with rival claims.

name: Crown Gallery
description: A private gallery where an invitation carries more weight than an advertisement.

name: Regent Holdings
description: A portfolio of high-end properties. Stable income makes a lasting statement.

name: Sovereign Room
description: A discreet exchange for the city's most powerful circles. Keeping it quiet is a daily expense.
